description: This horizontal grouped bar chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from the Whisper large model across various applied optimizations for two different models. The vertical axis contains the categories, labeled "Optimisations applied," listing the categories from top to bottom as Normalised, Add Spacing, Remove Spacing, Americanisms, and Dates. The horizontal value axis is labeled "Difference in Average WER from Whisper large" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to just beyond 0.003, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 0.001. The chart displays grouped bars for each optimization category, visually arranged so that the top bar in each pair represents the "NESAC ft model" in orange, and the bottom bar represents the "SESHA ft model" in green, as defined by the legend titled "Model" at the bottom of the chart. Every bar is visually emphasized with an explicit annotation of its exact numeric value at its right end. For the "Normalised" category, the orange bar is 0.00334 and the green bar is 0.00323. In "Add Spacing," the orange bar is 0.00319 while the green bar reaches the maximum length in the chart at 0.00344. The "Remove Spacing" category shows 0.00311 for orange and 0.00306 for green. "Americanisms" has an orange bar at 0.00299 and a green bar at 0.00302. Finally, the "Dates" category contains the shortest bars, with the orange bar at 0.00257 and the green bar representing the minimum value across the entire chart at 0.00228. The categories are not strictly sorted alphabetically or by absolute value, though the bar lengths generally trend downward from the top of the chart to the bottom.
